metadata.description: Book-production skills for writing, structuring and typesetting academic textbooks and monographs in LaTeX — the form/production side of a book project. Experimental, shared as-is with no warranty or liability. Responsibility rests entirely with whoever runs the skill — research integrity, institutional AI policy, publisher contract, copyright clearance, GDPR and the accuracy of every citation stay yours; the developer carries none of it and gives no assurance about your work. Everything runs locally; the developer receives nothing. Source verification assumes institutional library access for full-text checks (written around a CBS login; substitutable with your own university's access).

plugins.name: academic-book
plugins.description: Structure, number, build and typeset an academic textbook or monograph in LaTeX — chapter templates, box/case numbering, front/back matter, cover and print-quality checklists.

plugins.name: faglig-bog
plugins.description: Dansk søster til academic-book: struktur, nummerering, LaTeX-build og trykklargøring af en faglig lærebog eller monografi.

plugins.name: pm-konsistens-audit
plugins.description: Consistency and reference audit for a LaTeX textbook: consecutive numbering per chapter, dangling cross-references, concept-register/appendix pointers, references.bib integrity and typeless box-pointers.

plugins.name: academic-source-verification
plugins.description: Three-check citation verification (metadata/DOI plus content) and a reference-ledger builder for academic manuscripts — flags unverifiable sources, never fabricates references. The claim-fidelity check reads source full text and is written around a CBS-login backend; substitute your own institutional library access (EZproxy/OpenAthens/Shibboleth). Metadata and retraction checks need no login. Experimental, no warranty — verify every result yourself.

plugins.name: pm-bog
plugins.description: Opt-in project skill for one specific textbook (CBS Performance Management) — chapter map, LaTeX build, box definitions and known-good baseline facts. Published for reproducibility, not reuse: it will not be useful for your book. Invoke by name only.

plugins.name: akademisk-tekstaudit
plugins.description: Evidensbaseret kvalitetsaudit af danske akademiske tekster — 5 dimensioner, BARS-forankret 0–4-rubrik, konfidensbånd og tekstbelæg pr. score. Måler og flager; omskriver aldrig.

plugins.name: academic-english-text-audit
plugins.description: Evidence-based quality audit of English academic prose — 5 dimensions, anchored 0–4 rubric, confidence bands and verbatim evidence per score. Measures and flags; never rewrites.

plugins.name: academic-translation-da-en
plugins.description: Craft-level workflow for translating Danish academic books into English: decision log, termbase/anchor sign-off, per-section workflow, citation fidelity as a hard rule.

plugins.name: academic-danish-klarsprog
plugins.description: Register- og klarsprogsløft for danske akademiske manuskripter via valgbare stilprofiler (LIX, nominal/verbalstil, anglicismer, sætningsrytme). Rører aldrig mening, tal eller citater.

plugins.name: academic-danish-consistency
plugins.description: Bogdækkende dansk house-style-konsistensaudit: udleder stilark og termbase fra kapitlerne og flager afvigelser — omskriver aldrig stiltiende.

plugins.name: academic-english-narrative
plugins.description: Register and narrative-voice editing for English academic manuscripts through selectable style presets calibrated against measurable features. Body prose only; never alters meaning, citations or numbers.

plugins.name: academic-english-consistency
plugins.description: Book-wide English house-style consistency audit: derives a style sheet and termbase from the chapters and flags deviations — never silently rewrites.

plugins.name: academic-danish-ai-tell-audit
plugins.description: Måler tætheden af LLM-stilmarkører i dansk akademisk prosa og anbefaler reduktioner, der respekterer tekstens egen stemme. Måler og flager — omskriver aldrig; ikke en AI-detektor.

plugins.name: academic-english-ai-tell-audit
plugins.description: Measures the density of LLM-overused style markers in English academic prose and recommends reductions that respect the text's own voice. Measures and flags — never rewrites; not an AI detector.

plugins.name: academic-danish-engagement-audit
plugins.description: Rapportérbar læse-engagement-score for dansk akademisk prosa med registerbevidste anbefalinger. Måler kun; ingen dekorative virkemidler (seductive details skader læring).

plugins.name: academic-english-engagement-audit
plugins.description: Reportable reading-engagement score for English academic prose with register-aware recommendations. Measures only; no decorative 'interest' (seductive details harm learning).
